name: service-sheet
title: Service sheet
for_each: select id,name from venues order by name

sections.title: Upcoming arrivals
sections.note: Internal use. Check the booking and kitchen handover before service.
sections.sql: select reference,guest,arrival,dining_table,covers,status,allergy_note,kitchen_ack_by from v_service where venue_id=$1 and ends_at>now() and status in ('confirmed','seated') order by starts_at

name: kitchen-handover
title: Kitchen handover
for_each: select id,name from venues order by name

sections.title: Declared dietary needs
sections.note: This record does not establish that a meal is safe. The kitchen verifies ingredients and cross-contact controls with the guest.
sections.sql: select reference,arrival,covers,allergy_note,kitchen_ack_by from v_service where venue_id=$1 and allergy_note<>'' and ends_at>now() and status in ('confirmed','seated') order by starts_at
